source_document.title: MetaIndux-TS: Frequency-Aware AIGC Foundation Model for Industrial Time Series
source_document.venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems, vol. 36, no. 10, October 2025
source_document.table_title: Performance on zero-shot learning tasks of different diffusion models

protocol: Only normal-condition data train the generator; generated full-lifecycle data train a two-layer LSTM evaluated on real fatigue-condition data (Section IV-D, printed page 18071).
audit_note: The paper defines normal as RUL > 30 and fatigue as RUL < 30 but does not state how equality at RUL=30 is handled. Values visually transcribed from PDF page 9; no local zero-shot results exist yet.
